objective: Repair the screenshot-reported Badge and profile-photo UI defects, make Badge categories explicit instead of hidden horizontal scrollers, improve unapproved generic Badge glyphs, and keep saved side badges beneath hearts on Feed, Messages, and Cruushes.
userOutcome: Members can understand and use the Badge menu on mobile, crop a profile photo without a blank or clipped editor, and see their selected side badges consistently beneath heart photos across the named people surfaces.
audience: Authenticated cruush members editing profiles and browsing Feed, Messages, and Cruushes.
successCriteria: The embedded Badge preview never overlaps the Edit Profile header or Save button.
Badge categories use an explicit mobile selector rather than a horizontally hidden chip row.
Badge option cards fit long labels without overflow at the supplied Android width.
The profile photo cropper uses a reliable local preview URL and keeps its image, controls, and confirmation button inside the mobile viewport.
Saved side badges render directly beneath the heart photo in the shared Feed, Messages, and Cruushes capsule.
Only generic fallback Badge glyphs change; every previously selected custom, Hanky, role, position, and Pride glyph remains unchanged.
mustPreserve: Preserve every user-selected Noun Project asset and supplied custom badge symbol already recorded in source and design history.
Preserve Badge save behavior, left/right meaning, Circle frame, Hanky colors, map geometry, existing profile values, and adjacent profile tabs.
Preserve the current Feed, Messages, and Cruushes card content, actions, ordering, and heart size.
nonGoals: Do not change map tiles, map theme, Ghost Mode, Dark Room, Crowd behavior, Feed reactions, or replies.
Do not add unlicensed Flaticon or Noun Project files or a new dependency.
Do not run tests, build, push, or deploy; Julien will test this release slice.

assumptions.statement: External icon libraries are research references unless the exact asset has a confirmed cruush license.
assumptions.impact: Unlicensed candidate files will not enter the repository; generic fallbacks may use original or existing library glyphs informed by the research.

nextVisibleMilestone: Commit the complete screenshot repair slice for Julien's Android test.
stopConditions: Stop before push, deployment, purchasing an icon, or importing an asset whose license is not confirmed.
